gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: IGNORE_EXTENDED_RANGES has ordinal 2, so its bit vector value is 1L << 2 = 4L
ADDED i3: An empty long array means no bits are set, so the resulting EnumSet must be empty
ADDED i4: The enum constant name comparison must be case-insensitive
ADDED i5: A null name cannot match any enum constant
ADDED i6: The mock makes every enum's int value equal to 3; getFirstEnum(value=3) must return the first matching enum, which is AUTOSELECT_FILTERING (ordinal 0)
ADDED i7: A null enum class is not a valid enum type, so the default must be returned
ADDED i8: "+" is not a valid FilteringMode name, so the default enum must be returned
ADDED i9: AUTOSELECT_FILTERING has ordinal 0, so its bit vector in the long[] is 1L
ADDED i10: The mock always returns 0, which does not match -1, so getFirstEnum returns the default (AUTOSELECT_FILTERING). The array of 9 elements collapses to just AUTOSE
ADDED i11: -1 never matches 0, so getFirstEnum returns the default AUTOSELECT_FILTERING
ADDED i12: All 5 FilteringMode values have ordinals 0-4, so all bits 0-4 are set: 1+2+4+8+16 = 31L
ADDED i13: An empty string is not a valid system property key, so no enum is found and the default is returned
ADDED i14: 2800L in binary has bit 4 set (among others above ordinal 4), so only EXTENDED_FILTERING (ordinal 4) is included
ADDED i15: A null class cannot have enum constants to compare against
ADDED i16: getEnumMap must return all declared constants of the enum
ADDED i17: A null class cannot have enum constants, so the name cannot be valid
ADDED i18: EnumUtils provides a public no-arg constructor for JavaBean compatibility
